w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Callback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Buffering mauled Wanjiru (-46 health) over 15 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: This patch is picked clean — it comes back in a few days. Work another green patch meanwhile.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Mushrooms thumb up through the duff in a ring — a fairy ring, old as the path. You step around it, not through it. Some rules are older than knowledge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Mason freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Mason: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext:
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.
It followed you. The Ugly Beast is here.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Mateo freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Contract Quill. It has signed three leases, two loans, and one terrible contract you still regret. The penmanship was always excellent. The judgment, less so. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.

Travel 1 tile to meadow.
— Open ground —
Open sky for the first time in a while. Hawks circle — something down there is being watched.
Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
👁️ Mateo freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Wanjiru: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: Your pack is full — water is heavy (1L = 1kg). Drink some or drop weight before filling.
Travel 3 tiles to meadow.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
👁️ Mateo freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🍲 David is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."
📺 SYSTEM: "═══ CONTEST INTERRUPTION ═══"

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🤒 Victoria is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. Fernando is already boiling water. It's handled.
Herbal remedy on Victoria: the right plants, brewed dark — the feverish breaks and doesn't come back. Victoria is going to make it. (Fernando cured them — and the camp saw it.)

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 0 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 68 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE NETWORK NOTE! You're on your own.
firstContext: No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You don't know what that was. A memo, cc'd to the sky. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE NETWORK NOTE! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE NETWORK NOTE! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 9 · Craft 10 · Talk 14 · Explore 25 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Fernando Téllez ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
